title: Plain-Text Chunk Streaming Architecture for Gemini on Vercel Serverless
author: Johnson Samuel / Book-to-Skill Forge

claims.assertion: Streaming Plain-Text HTTP chunks via Node.js res.write() and generateContentStream bypasses token completion wait times and provides immediate perceived responsiveness in serverless runtimes.
Cross-domain embedded chat widgets require serverless handlers to explicitly intercept OPTIONS preflight requests and return 200 OK before the browser allows streaming POST requests.
Consuming streamed HTTP chunks in web frontends requires ReadableStreamDefaultReader with TextDecoder running an incremental state accumulation loop rather than awaiting res.text() or res.json().
